settings.title: Auto-save open tabs
settings.description: Saves your open tabs as a new group in the Auto-saved section, on a schedule or when you open many tabs. Tabs that are already saved are skipped, and private windows are never saved. Every auto-save is kept.
settings.descriptionFree: Saves your open tabs as a new group in the Auto-saved section, on a schedule or when you open many tabs. Tabs that are already saved are skipped, and private windows are never saved. The Free plan keeps the newest {{keep}} auto-saves, and they count toward your {{groups}} groups and {{tabs}} tabs.
settings.thresholdAria: Open-tab count that starts an auto-save
settings.notifyDescription: A browser notification after each auto-save.
settings.noTrigger: Pick a schedule or a tab count to auto-save.

banner.rolling_other: Saved automatically. The Free plan keeps the newest {{count}} auto-saves: the next one replaces the oldest. Keep it as a group to hold on to it.
